label: NZEUG AGM held during the 2018 New Zealand Esri User Conference
summary: The published programme places the user-group AGM in an afternoon community session facilitated by Roland Pomana. Concurrent programme tracks include conservation, local-government services, central-government GIS, land information, enterprise systems and GIS data. Eagle's 2019 sponsorship prospectus retrospectively reported more than 550 delegates at the 2018 conference.

sources.label: Eagle Technology, NZEUC 2019 sponsorship prospectus reporting 2018 attendance
